idea-plugin.name: API HTTP Generator
idea-plugin.description:
Writes IntelliJ HTTP Client requests for Spring REST controllers and SPQR GraphQL resolvers, and copies Java classes as JSON filled with realistic fake values, so endpoints can be tested without leaving the IDE.

Generate requests

  • Gutter icon on a handler or resolver, Alt+Enter on a method or class name, the editor menu, or Ctrl+Alt+Shift+H.
  • Requests go to .local/http/<Class>.http; running again only appends what is missing.
  • Every request has a ### title and a unique # @name for the Services tool window.
  • REST: {{HOST}} URLs, path variables and ids as file variables you set once, query or form parameters, headers and a JSON body.
  • SPQR GraphQL: a login request that stores access_token, operation variables typed the way SPQR names them (SearchRequestInput), and a three-level selection set.
  • http-client.env.json and http-client.private.env.json are created with HOST from server.port, plus the login keys for GraphQL.

Copy as JSON

  • With Fake Values (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+J): fixed values that paste anywhere.
  • With $random Placeholders (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+K): {{$random...}} for .http files.
  • Works on a class, a field, a parameter, or a method's body or parameters.

Fake values

Chosen from validation constraints first (@Email, @Size, @Min/@Max, @Pattern, @Past/@Future), then about 60 field-name hints, then the Java type:

email{{$random.internet.emailAddress}}
firstName / lastName / fullName{{$random.name.firstName}} and similar
phone, mobile{{$random.phoneNumber.cellPhone}}
city, street, address, zip, country, region{{$random.address.*}}
company, department, industry, title{{$random.company.name}}, commerce.department, ...
description / message / tag{{$random.lorem.sentence}} / paragraph / word
uid, uuid{{$uuid}}
salary, amount, price{{$random.integer(1000, 5000001)}}
password and its confirmationone fixed strong value, so they match
page / pageSize / sortBy0 / 10 / null
dates, booleans, enumsfixed values (the HTTP Client has no generator for them)

Own ids inside payloads are null, @GeneratedValue fields are left out and search filters are empty, so generated requests are accepted. The full table is in the README.

Shortcuts are deliberately unusual; rebind them in Settings > Keymap.
